verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance and case-management platform that markets customer screening, so configurable name matching is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows configurable name-matching settings or any way to inspect alias or transliteration matches. The marketing line about screening customers with customizable automation is too generic to count as this capability.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can configure name matching and inspect alias or transliteration matches
